column1: # The Temple unit menu, read off a vanilla Art of Conquest game. Format and
# It never rotates. Two positions, a Priest and a Prophet, from the Temple's
# first epoch to the last — everything else on the Temple's screen is research,
# which lives in the technology tables and not here. So the Temple contributes
# no slot succession at all, and neither unit's check can ever be lost to a
# Recorded anyway. "No rotation" is a finding, and without it written down the
# next person has to open the game to learn that the Prophet is safe.
